description: Edit the post's CURRENT image in place (same path as the in-app chat image edit). Default keeps everything else the same; brand marks are left out unless the instruction asks for them. The replaced image is appended to generation_metadata.image_history so bamf.revert_post_version can restore it. Pass reference_version (an image_history index) to also give the editor an earlier version. Always updates post_id; never creates a post. Returns an async job.
name: bamf.edit_post_image
